name: prune-for-x
description: Find the dead accounts you follow on X and unfollow them at a safe pace. Local-only browser extension.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.zip: rm -f prune.zip && zip -rq prune.zip manifest.json src icons -x 'icons/icon512.png'
